tensor_dot_lowering_probe.description: MX FP4 (E2M1 packed two per uint8, E8M0 unit scales) tl.dot_scaled lowering, exact-product and scale-application probe

timing.method: backend events around batches; elapsed / actual launch count; no cache flush
timing.includes: kernel work, device scheduling and amortized event overhead; events mode additionally includes host dispatch gaps
timing.excludes: JIT compilation, allocation, initialization, validation, capture and warmup

results.input_pattern: random E2M1 codes for +/-0.5 and +/-1.0, packed two per uint8; unit E8M0 scales; dense tl.dot_scaled operations
results.accumulation_policy: MX E2M1 multiply with E8M0 group scaling and FP32 accumulation

correctness.tolerance_basis: accumulated accumulator unit roundoff over all iterations, far below the 1/256 exact-operand lattice step
